description.value: The Chilliwack Cultural Centre is the Fraser Valley's primary performing arts and creative hub, featuring two performance theatres, an art gallery, 21 music studios, and four arts and crafts studios on the traditional territory of the Stó:lō Coast Salish People. It presents live theatre, concerts, gallery exhibitions, and creative classes year-round, making it a significant cultural stop for cyclists passing through Chilliwack.
